sections.heading: Progression Requirements
lines: To remain in a BMOS SPECIALIZATION students must maintain a minimum cumulative average of 65%. In order to be readmitted to a BMOS Specialization students must complete an additional 5.0 courses in another discipline and must meet the Admission Requirements.

sections.heading: Graduation Requirements
lines: To graduate from the BMOS SPECIALIZATION, students must achieve a minimum cumulative average of 65% on the 20.0 courses counted towards the BMOS SPECIALIZATION Degree. Students with advanced standing must achieve an overall average of 65% on courses completed at Western. All students require 2.0 designated essay courses (E, F or G; at least 1.0 of which must be a senior course numbered 2000- 4999) and 1.0 course from each of the Categories A, B and C.
